name: goal-loop-panel
description: The Goals view opens and finishes loading. The judgement is the step itself: the `goals-panel` opener only succeeds once the tab has been clicked and `[data-testid="goal-panel-loaded"]` is visible, so a green step means the panel mounted with its data rather than merely appeared. No expectation key is asserted because the reading vocabulary (`expectationFailures` in scripts/ui-scenario.mjs) has no goals field yet — inventing one would fail every run for the wrong reason. No goal is created, so the scenario cannot pollute the store.
